03The layout ladder — scroll it

00 · as received

Original

Products sit in stock-code order — no thought to where they're picked. The route sprawls across the whole floor, into the far aisles, every trip.

01 · intuition

ABC

Put the most-picked products nearest the dock. The obvious move — and it barely helps. Orders are 7 lines long, so the picker still visits most aisles. −2.5%.

02 · data insight

Affinity

Place products bought together in the same aisle. Now one trip stays local instead of crossing the floor. −11.3% — four times ABC.

03 · algorithm

Optimized

Simulated annealing over slot swaps, every candidate scored on the exact replay distance. The route collapses to two adjacent aisles. −15.8%.

you · the game

Your floor

183.7 km is the bar the algorithm set. Now it's yours — click two racks to swap them, watch the scoreboard move, and see if you can beat the optimizer. open the editor →

The key finding

ABC — the textbook answer — saves only 2.5%. Grouping products that are bought together saves 4–5× more.

Stack slotting + batching

Add smart batching on the best layout and the month's walk drops to 70 km — a 68% cut from 218.

Held-out check: layouts built only from orders before 22 Nov, tested on the final 766 unseen orders — Optimized still −13.9%.

06Inside the twin

More than a slotting toy.

Live optimizer

Simulated annealing on your layout in a Web Worker — 24,000 swaps in ~15 s, racks recolouring as it improves.

IoT sensor mode

The replay streams what real hardware would: RFID gates, UWB tags, pick-to-light lamps, barcode scans. Download as JSONL.

Team of pickers

1–6 pickers from one queue. A narrow aisle holds one cart; the next waits at the entrance. Congestion, not just distance.

Smart batching

Each trip grabs the three waiting orders whose aisles overlap most. Same orders, 12–15% less walking.

Heatmaps

Rack-visit and floor-traffic overlays on one colour ramp — a product keeps its colour across every layout and slide.

Runs fully offline

Render-on-demand WebGL — 0 draw calls while idle — baked lighting, instanced geometry. Opens from a folder.

See it move.
